<document id="disputes-denied">
IfˆyourˆdisputeˆisˆdeniedˆSometimesˆaˆdisputeˆisˆdecidedˆagainstˆyou.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆthatˆmeans.ˆ##ˆWhyˆdisputesˆareˆdeniedˆ-ˆTheˆmerchantˆshowedˆyouˆmadeˆorˆauthorizedˆtheˆpurchase,ˆforˆexampleˆwithˆdeliveryˆproofˆsignedˆatˆyourˆaddress.ˆ-ˆTheˆdisputeˆwasˆfiledˆafterˆitsˆwindowˆclosed.ˆ-ˆTheˆmerchantˆalreadyˆrefundedˆyou.ˆ-ˆTheˆissueˆisn'tˆcovered,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆpriceˆyouˆagreedˆtoˆandˆlaterˆchangedˆyourˆmindˆabout.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆtoˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆWeˆsendˆyouˆaˆwrittenˆexplanationˆfirst.ˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆlater,ˆweˆtakeˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆback.ˆIfˆthatˆleavesˆyourˆbalanceˆnegative,ˆaddˆmoneyˆsoˆyourˆaccountˆisn'tˆrestricted.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆappeal?ˆYes,ˆifˆyouˆhaveˆnewˆinformation.ˆReplyˆtoˆtheˆdecisionˆmessageˆwithˆtheˆnewˆdocumentsˆandˆwe'llˆreviewˆitˆagain.ˆWeˆcan'tˆreopenˆaˆdisputeˆjustˆbecauseˆyouˆdisagreeˆwithˆtheˆoutcome.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆSeeˆ"Negativeˆbalanceˆafterˆaˆdispute"ˆforˆhowˆrepaymentˆworks.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-merchant-v2">
DisputingˆaˆpurchaseˆwithˆaˆmerchantˆIfˆyouˆpaidˆforˆsomethingˆwithˆyourˆcardˆandˆthere'sˆaˆproblemˆwithˆtheˆpurchaseˆitself,ˆyouˆcanˆfileˆaˆmerchantˆdispute.ˆThisˆcovers:ˆ-ˆItemsˆorˆservicesˆyouˆpaidˆforˆbutˆneverˆreceivedˆ-ˆItemsˆthatˆwereˆsignificantlyˆdifferentˆfromˆwhatˆwasˆdescribedˆ-ˆSubscriptionsˆorˆrecurringˆchargesˆthatˆcontinuedˆafterˆyouˆcancelledˆ##ˆContactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirstˆBeforeˆyouˆdispute,ˆtryˆtoˆsortˆitˆoutˆwithˆtheˆmerchant,ˆandˆkeepˆaˆrecordˆofˆwhatˆyouˆsentˆandˆwhatˆtheyˆsaid.ˆWe'llˆaskˆforˆit.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆyouˆhaveˆFileˆaˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwithinˆ120ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆweˆcan'tˆopenˆaˆdisputeˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆfileˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆProblemˆwithˆaˆpurchase.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆuploadˆyourˆrecords.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆWeˆthenˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆthroughˆtheˆcardˆnetwork.ˆMostˆcasesˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆTransactionsˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognizeˆatˆallˆareˆaˆdifferentˆkindˆofˆdispute.ˆSeeˆ"Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmake".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-duplicate">
ChargedˆtwiceˆforˆtheˆsameˆthingˆSeeingˆtheˆsameˆchargeˆtwiceˆdoesn'tˆalwaysˆmeanˆyouˆwereˆchargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆCheckˆifˆoneˆisˆpendingˆHotels,ˆgasˆstations,ˆcarˆrentalsˆandˆrestaurantsˆoftenˆplaceˆaˆtemporaryˆauthorization,ˆthenˆpostˆtheˆfinalˆamountˆseparately.ˆTheˆpendingˆoneˆusuallyˆdropsˆoffˆwithinˆ7ˆdays.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ##ˆIfˆbothˆhaveˆpostedˆIfˆtwoˆidenticalˆchargesˆhaveˆbothˆposted,ˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirst.ˆMostˆwillˆrefundˆaˆduplicateˆquickly.ˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆdoesn'tˆhelp,ˆdisputeˆtheˆsecondˆchargeˆinˆtheˆappˆasˆaˆduplicate.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆChargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆDuplicateˆfeesˆIfˆweˆchargedˆyouˆtheˆsameˆfeeˆtwice,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆAˆfeeˆchargedˆinˆerrorˆisˆalwaysˆrefunded.ˆ##ˆTimeˆlimitˆDuplicateˆchargesˆfollowˆtheˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwindow:ˆ120ˆdaysˆfromˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆ##ˆSplitˆpaymentsˆSomeˆmerchantsˆsplitˆoneˆorderˆintoˆseveralˆcharges,ˆforˆexampleˆwhenˆitemsˆshipˆseparately.ˆCheckˆyourˆorderˆconfirmationˆbeforeˆyouˆdispute.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
